bio: At Bruis, located in the centre of Haarlem, Jozua Jaring of MICHELIN-starred Ratatouille gives the floor to the next generation of culinary talent. Out front, the pavement terrace is all set; inside, the lighting underscores the intimate character of this cosy establishment. The chefs invite you to compose your own set menu from an enticing selection of French-inspired dishes with a contemporary twist. Expect dishes such as pan-seared sea bass with pancetta and a delicately zesty antiboise sauce with fresh herbs. A fitting finale comes in the form of a Paris-Brest featuring silky buttercream, caramel ice cream; a sprinkling of coarse salt rounds off this generous dessert. Get ready to savour indulgent flavours in a relaxed setting.
